message_1_subject: MAP & Eval: final signoff, DocuSign window, and July 1 start
message_1_body:
Hi Liam / Priya,

Thanks again for running the evaluation with your platform team — appreciate the thoughtful feedback in EvalReport_final (attached). Per our MAP, we're at the final close steps and I'd like to lock timing so procurement and your legal team can schedule the sign-off.

Attached: MAP_v3.xlsx (mutual action plan with milestone owners), EvalReport_final.pdf, and SOW_Redwood_v2.docx (draft SOW with pricing and success metrics).

High-level ask: please confirm the following by EOD Friday 5/7 so we can get DocuSign out next week and hit a July 1 start:  
- Procurement: confirm preferred PO format and if a PO number will be issued pre-signature or post-signature.
- Legal: any remaining redlines in the SOW (Ben / Karthik will be on standby to accept or clarify).
- Security: finalize the SOC2 evidence bundle link (I included links in the Drive folder).

Proposed DocuSign window: Tue 5/11 - Wed 5/12 (we can accomodate signer timezones). If that works, we'll create an envelope and propose individual signing slots (we can do sequential signing: Procurement -> Legal -> Exec).

Target start date: July 1, 2027 (dependent on signed SOW + PO and completion of the MAP acceptance items).

Next steps from our side: Ben will incorporate any minor redlines into a final SOW v3 and I will prepare the DocuSign envelope and the final MAP with owner checkboxes.

Notes: If procurement needs a longer review window, tell us the minimum lead time and we'll adjust the signature schedule — we want to avoid a last-minute rush that would push the July 1 start out.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v3.xlsx] [Attachment: EvalReport_final.pdf] [Attachment: SOW_Redwood_v2.docx]
message_2_subject: Re: MAP & Eval: final signoff, DocuSign window, and July 1 start
message_2_body:
Rachel — thanks for the materials and the clear plan. Quick notes from Procurement/Legal side: 

- Procurement: we typically issue a PO after the SOW is countersigned, but can provide a PO hold/intent if required. We need the final SOW with firm rates (no placeholders) to file the PO.
- Legal: Priya flagged one commercial redline (limitation of liability paragraph) and one data residency note. She'll circulate comments by EOD 5/4.
- Security: our InfoSec team asked for the SOC2 report and the retention policy for inference logs — can you confirm where those live in your Drive folder?

DocuSign window 5/11-5/12 looks feasible but Procurement requests we allow a backup slot on 5/18 in case of internal approvals taking longer.

Lastly: can you confirm the exact invoice cadence and early-termination refund language? Our finance team wants to align on invoice schedule prior to countersign.

Liam
Head of Platform Integrations, Atlantic Retail
On behalf of Procurement: procurement@atlantic-retail.com

I'll be on the envelope as signer for Redwood legal when it's created.

message_4_subject: Final: DocuSign envelope + sign-off timeline (5/11 primary, 5/18 backup)
message_4_body:
Thanks all — summarizing the confirmed plan so everyone's aligned.

1) SOW: Ben's marked SOW (SOW_Redwood_v2_marked.docx) will be uploaded to the Drive folder. Priya, if you can confirm the two redlines are acceptable by EOD 5/6, Ben will finalize and we will not re-open commercial terms.

2) DocuSign envelope: I will create the envelope today with sequential signing order (Procurement -> Legal -> Exec). Primary signing window: Tue 5/11 (09:00-17:00 ET) / Wed 5/12 (09:00-17:00 ET). Backup signing window: Tue 5/18 (same hours). Envelope link: https://docusign.company/envelopes/ENV-9912 (active once I send).

3) PO & invoicing: Liam — please confirm if you will provide a PO number pre-signature or within three business days post-signature. Invoice cadence will be quarterly in arrears unless you request monthly. Early-termination refund: standard pro-rata refund for unused committed capacity; clause is in Section 6 of the SOW.

4) Security: SOC2 report and retention policy are in the Drive folder at https://drive.company/drive/folders/1a2Bmap. If InfoSec needs anything additional, loop me directly and we'll pull a tailored bundle.

5) Start date: contingent on signed SOW + PO, target start = July 1, 2027. If PO or signature slips beyond 5/18, we'll need to re-evaluate onboarding capacity and may push the start by up to 2 weeks.

Please reply with explicit confirmation of: (A) Priya confirms redlines by 5/6, (B) Procurement confirms PO timing, (C) Liam confirms primary signing window works. If I have all three by EOD 5/6 I'll send the DocuSign envelope first thing on 5/7.
